kandy.arrival: Arrive at Colombo International Airport. Meet & greet by our representative and proceed to Kandy, stopping en route to visit the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage. Upon reaching Kandy, explore the city with a guided city tour. Later, check in and relax at the hotel.
kandy.transitIn: Travel to Kandy, stopping en route at scenic points of interest along the way. Upon arrival, explore Kandy with a guided city tour before checking in and relaxing at the hotel.
extra: Full day at leisure in Kandy — visit the Temple of the Tooth Relic, the Royal Botanical Gardens at Peradeniya, and explore the local markets around the lake.
kandy.departure: Breakfast at the hotel. Later, transfer to the airport in time for your departure flight — leaving Sri Lanka with beautiful memories.

bentota.arrival: Arrive at Colombo International Airport. Meet & greet by our representative and proceed directly to Bentota. Check in and relax at the resort.
bentota.transitIn: Proceed to Bentota through scenic countryside and coastal landscapes. Upon arrival, enjoy leisure time at Bentota Beach and relax at the resort.
extra: Explore Bentota — take part in a Madu River boat ride, visit the Turtle Centre and try the Fish Spa, or spend the day at leisure with optional water sports.
bentota.departure: Breakfast at the hotel. Later, transfer to the airport in time for your departure flight — leaving Sri Lanka with beautiful memories.

colombo.arrival: Arrive at Colombo International Airport. Meet & greet by our representative and transfer directly to your hotel in Colombo.
colombo.transitIn: Drive to Colombo, enjoying a city tour covering Independence Square, Galle Face Green, Gangaramaya Temple and the Old Parliament. Finish the day with some shopping.
extra: Full day at leisure in Colombo, with time for shopping and optional excursions.
colombo.departure: Breakfast at the hotel. Later, transfer to the airport in time for your departure flight — leaving Sri Lanka with beautiful memories.
